segments.sn45.50-54:1.1: 50-54. “Sūriyassa, bhikkhave, udayato etaṃ pubbaṅgamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, yadidaṃ – aruṇuggaṃ;
segments.sn45.50-54:1.2: evameva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa uppādāya etaṃ pubbaṅgamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, yadidaṃ – sīlasampadā.
segments.sn45.50-54:1.3: Sīlasampannassetaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ … yadidaṃ – chandasampadā … yadidaṃ – attasampadā … yadidaṃ – diṭṭhisampadā … yadidaṃ – appamādasampadā ….
